body.statement: For every \(P_{\mathrm{obs}}\in\mathfrak P_{\mathrm{IV}}\) and stratum \(x\), the published response-function compatibility fiber projects to \(\mathcal M_x(p_x)=\{Cw_x:w_x\in\mathcal W_x(p_x)\}\). Composing that polytope with the standard finite-scenario randomized-regret program gives \(R_x(q,p_x)=\max_{b,\beta}G_{(b,\beta),\cdot}(p_x)q\), and feasible-basis enumeration returns \(Q_x^*(p_x)\) and \(v_x(p_x)\), including tied optimal faces.
body.justification: The lemma fixes the population optimization notation consumed by the coefficient-varying KKT and inference results.
body.gap: SongEtAl2026CategoricalIV supplies the compatible response-law polytope and MastinJailletChin2014RandomizedRegret supplies the finite randomized-regret linear program, so their composition is treated as background rather than a new theorem-level contribution.
body.consumer: All later certificates, the exact witness, and the moving-coefficient limit theorem use this common finite saddle representation.
